{{Quote|The Kaikielii had been a key power at the dawn of the Republic, and its governors accepted homage from numerous colony planets&mdash;Ruan, the moons of Jonsior, even Foerost. But over the millennia, these achieved full membership and shifting fate left the hub behind.|Doctor Gabrel Treon, "Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes"|<ref name="Tinker" />}}
The '''moons of Jonsior'''<ref name="Tinker" /> were located in the [[Jonsior system/Legends|Jonsior system]]. They were a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA Jonsior" /> During the early history of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="Tinker" /> which was [[Galactic Constitution Conference|founded]] in [[25,053 BBY]],<ref name="TORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the [[Colonist/Legends|settlers]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of Jonsior paid homage to the [[Governor/Legends|governors]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]],<ref name="Tinker" /> located in the [[Kaikielius system/Legends|Kaikielius system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> That changed, however, when the moons became full members of the Republic during the [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] leading up to approximately [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. The historical allegiance of the moons of Jonsior to Kaikielius was briefly noted in [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gabrel Treon]]'s [[104 ABY]] article "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes]]" that was published in the [[Byblos Journal of Historical Science]].<ref name="Tinker" />

==Behind the scenes==
The moons of Jonsior were introduced in "[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]," an article authored by [[Nathan O'Keefe]] and published as part of the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature on [[February 5]], [[2009]].<ref name="Tinker" /> The [[August 18]], 2009<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Jonsior [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the moons, in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA Jonsior" />
